repo_notes.content: This is an Android app (Spotilol) that wraps the Spotify Web Player in a WebView. It injects custom JS/CSS to block ads/analytics, spoof the browser fingerprint, bypass GDPR dialogs, add custom player controls, and expose a library browser. Written in Kotlin using Jetpack Compose. The project is a clean-Kotlin port of deviato's Spotifuck. Priority areas: webview/ (JS injection engine), service/ (media + offline playback), offline/ + innertube/ + yt/ (YouTube-backed offline downloads), and bridge/ (JS <-> Kotlin).
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: webview/ holds the core engine. SpotifyWebViewClient orchestrates per-page JS injection and request interception; SpotifyWebChromeClient handles fullscreen/custom view and progress. webview/injections/ contains 32 Kotlin objects, each exposing a const val CONTENT with raw JavaScript (BrowserSpoof, FetchOverride, PlayerCore, TrackObserver, MediaUpdater, LibraryFetcher, LibraryParser, PlaybackControls, AndroidAuto, MainLoop, AutoFeatures, AndroidTracker, PowerSave, SearchOverlay, DownloadButton, DownloadProgress, CssHack, SpotilolPlayer, FbGdprBypass, ClassicLoginButton, LogoutCheck, LoginDetection, GoogleSpoof, WorkerNeutralize, AdStateHook, GaBlocker, SettingsFix, ModalFix, ErrorDialogRestyle, ToastFix, LyricsSyncFix, ClassicBridge). Order of injection in injectPlayerControl matters (PlayerCore defines globals first). webview/helpers/ has JsUtils (console log stripping), AmoledTheme, CssInjector, AdBlocker, AdIdStore, DevLogPrelude. AndroidAuto.kt is the Android Auto media-browser/search JS (fetchMediaItems, searchMediaItems, checkMediaLib, ensureAuthToken, playFromUri with contextUri).
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: service/ contains MediaNotificationService (a MediaBrowserServiceCompat providing lock-screen controls and Android Auto browsing/search/playback via MediaSessionCompat, wakeAndRun to resume a backgrounded WebView, Bluetooth/noisy audio routing, custom actions for favorite/shuffle/repeat) and OfflineMediaService (foreground player for downloaded tracks). bridge/ contains SpotifyBridge which exposes @JavascriptInterface methods to the WebView JS context (AndBridge): media status/position, media items + search results for Android Auto, download track payloads, PiP requests, login/playLoaded signals, and a native fetch fallback (nFetch) used by ClassicBridge.
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

repo_notes.content: offline/ (DownloadManager, OfflineStore) implements YouTube-backed offline downloads. It resolves Spotify track metadata, searches YouTube via a custom InnerTube API client under innertube/ (InnerTube, YouTube, NetworkConfig, YouTubeConstants, models/, pages/, utils/), then extracts streamable audio under yt/ (YTPlayerUtils, AudioQuality, CandidateScorer, cipher/ with PlayerJsFetcher + CipherDeobfuscator, potoken/ PoToken generation, sabr/ streaming parser). profile/ has ProfileManager for account profiles. util/ has UpdateChecker + GitHubApi (release checking), DebugLogStore, Markdown. proxy/ has LocalProxyManager (optional MITM local proxy with generated CA cert). ui/ has Compose screens: SplashActivity, MainActivity (WebView host + player overlay), OfflineActivity, screens/SettingsScreen, plus theme/.
repo_notes.author: Maintainer

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: High-level architecture of Spotilol: how the WebView, JS injection engine, Android services, Android Auto integration, and the YouTube-backed offline downloader interact to wrap and enhance the Spotify Web Player

pages.title: WebView & JS Injection System
pages.purpose: How SpotifyWebViewClient orchestrates JS injection on each page load (onPageStarted vs onPageFinished vs injectPlayerControl), which injections are gated on login state, and how SpotifyWebChromeClient handles child windows and fullscreen video

pages.title: JS Injection Objects Reference
pages.purpose: Detailed reference for each of the 32 JS injection objects in webview/injections/ - what each one does, its key exported window functions/variables, and when it is injected. Cover ad-blocking (AdStateHook, GaBlocker, WorkerNeutralize, FetchOverride), spoofing (BrowserSpoof, GoogleSpoof, desktop fingerprint), player core + globals (PlayerCore, TrackObserver, MediaUpdater, PlaybackControls), Android Auto JS (AndroidAuto), UI features (CssHack, SpotilolPlayer, AutoFeatures, AndroidTracker, PowerSave, SearchOverlay, DownloadButton, DownloadProgress), and page helpers (ClassicLoginButton, FbGdprBypass, LoginDetection, LogoutCheck, ClassicBridge, SettingsFix, ModalFix, ErrorDialogRestyle, ToastFix, LyricsSyncFix, MainLoop)

pages.title: Helper Utilities
pages.purpose: Documentation of webview/helpers/: JsUtils (console.log stripping algorithm + cache), AmoledTheme (AMOLED CSS builder), CssInjector (custom CSS injection), AdBlocker + AdIdStore (analytics/ad CDN blocking and request-id tracking), DevLogPrelude (debug overlay logging hooks)

pages.title: Kotlin-JS Bridge (SpotifyBridge)
pages.purpose: Document every @JavascriptInterface method exposed to the WebView as window.AndBridge: loginDetected, playLoaded, deferMessage, isWoke/wakeUp/wakeOff, cssInjected, recMediaStatus/recMediaPosition, recAccountName, onMediaItemsLoaded/onSearchCompleted (Android Auto), downloadTrack, enterPip/enterPipVideo, openTimerDialog, manageTShut/manageTSleep, dbg, and the nFetch native-fetch fallback used by ClassicBridge in normal (non-proxy) mode

pages.title: Media Notification & Android Auto Service
pages.purpose: How MediaNotificationService (a MediaBrowserServiceCompat) provides: the foreground media notification, lock-screen/Bluetooth/Wear controls via MediaSessionCompat, Android Auto root categories (playlists/albums/artists/podcasts) + async onLoadChildren/onSearch with pendingCallbacks and timeouts, onPlayFromMediaId + wakeAndRun (resumeTimers/onResume/visibility) to execute JS while the WebView is backgrounded, custom actions (favorite/shuffle/repeat), Bluetooth/noisy audio auto pause/resume, and metadata/cover art loading

pages.title: Android Auto Media Browsing Flow
pages.purpose: End-to-end flow for Android Auto: onGetRoot extras, root categories, JS fetchMediaItems/checkMediaLib/pendingMediaRequests draining via window.mediaLib, JSON payload parsing (name/id/image/artists/browsable flags) back in Kotlin onMediaItemsLoaded, onSearch (searchDesktop GQL), and playback via playFromUri(mediaId, contextId) -> connect-state command

pages.title: Offline Playback Service
pages.purpose: How OfflineMediaService plays downloaded tracks as a foreground service with its own MediaSession, and how it relates to the offline/ store (OfflineStore) and the main webview player

pages.title: Offline Downloads (YouTube-backed)
pages.purpose: How the offline downloader works: DownloadManager consumes a Spotify track payload from JS (DownloadButton/DownloadProgress), resolves metadata, searches YouTube, extracts an audio stream, downloads it, and stores it via OfflineStore for OfflineMediaService

pages.title: YouTube InnerTube Client
pages.purpose: Documentation of innertube/: the custom InnerTube API client (InnerTube.kt, YouTube.kt, NetworkConfig.kt, YouTubeConstants.kt), its serialized models under models/, pagination/search under pages/, and utils/ - including how search and player responses are parsed for the offline downloader

pages.title: YouTube Audio Extraction & Cipher
pages.purpose: Documentation of yt/: YTPlayerUtils, AudioQuality selection, CandidateScorer, and the signature-cipher deobfuscation (cipher/ with PlayerJsFetcher + CipherDeobfuscator), PoToken/anti-bot generation (potoken/), and SABR streaming (sabr/) used to resolve playable audio streams

pages.title: MITM Proxy System
pages.purpose: How LocalProxyManager implements an optional local man-in-the-middle proxy with generated CA certificates (RSA 2048-bit leaf keypair caching) to intercept Spotify API traffic, plus the network_security_config and why this mode is optional vs the default normal mode

pages.title: UI Layer
pages.purpose: Documentation of ui/: MainActivity (Jetpack Compose host for the WebView, custom player overlay, PiP handling, service start/stop), SplashActivity (animated splash), OfflineActivity (downloaded tracks UI), screens/SettingsScreen (all preferences: AndAuto/Android Auto, APlayMode, ConnectionMode normal/proxy, AmoledTheme, CustomCss, BtAutoPause/Resume, sleep timer, PlayerMode spotilol/original, profiles), and theme/ (Saira font family, AMOLED dark theme)

pages.title: Profile Manager
pages.purpose: How ProfileManager stores, switches, saves, and deletes user account profiles (cookies/auth state per profile) and how it interacts with the account name detection in the JS bridge

pages.title: Utilities
pages.purpose: Documentation of util/: UpdateChecker + GitHubApi (release version checking against GitHub releases), DebugLogStore (in-memory ring buffer surfaced in the debug overlay), and Markdown (rendering helper)

pages.title: Build & Configuration
pages.purpose: Build system (Gradle Kotlin DSL + version catalog gradle/libs.versions.toml), module structure (app/), ProGuard keep rules for JS bridge and BouncyCastle, Firebase google-services.json requirement, AndroidManifest declarations (services, Android Auto automotive_app_desc meta-data), and network security config
